info.title: ArchivumParfums · API v1
info.description: API REST de ArchivumParfums: citas de prueba de olores, pedidos bajo pedido, decants y pagos para perfumerías. Las rutas y los atributos JSON están en español; los errores siguen el RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`).

get.summary: Describe the API and the version being served

post.summary: Keep the uploaded image as the logo of the business of the session; the answer exposes only its address

get.summary: Show the profile and the settings of the business of the session

patch.summary: Change the profile fields and settings sent for the business of the session

get.summary: Answer the data and the role of the account that owns the token
List the perfumes of the business of the session, active and inactive, one page at a time

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Register a perfume in the business of the session

get.summary: Show a perfume of the business of the session with its notes, tags and presentations

patch.summary: Change the fields sent of a perfume of the business of the session, also to deactivate or reactivate it

post.summary: Keep the uploaded image as the photo of a perfume of the business of the session; the answer exposes only its address

get.summary: List every presentation of a perfume of the business of the session, active or not

post.summary: Add a presentation to a perfume; repeated milliliters are reported on the field ml

patch.summary: Change the milliliters, the manual price or the state of a presentation; repeated milliliters are reported on the field ml

post.summary: Sign in with email and password and answer a bearer token

delete.summary: Sign out by revoking the token of the request

sanctum.description: Token de Sanctum que entrega `POST /sesiones`. Se envía como `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
